\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{ازدواج} \fa{کردن} (ezdevâj kardan)}{ازدواج کردن (ezdevâj kardan)}]{\fa{ازدواج} \fa{کردن} (ezdevâj kardan) — to marry}

\label{lesson:FA-C183-ezdevaj-kardan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for to translate, then the Persian for to talk.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{ازدواج} \fa{کردن}}
\textbf{\fa{ازدواج} \fa{کردن}} — \emph{ezdevâj kardan} — \textquotedblleft{}to marry\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{ezdevâj kardan} pairs \emph{ezdevâj}, borrowed from Arabic \emph{izdiwāj}, \textquotedblleft{}pairing, marriage\textquotedblright{} (root \emph{z-w-j}, Lane), with the Persian verb \emph{kardan}, \textquotedblleft{}to do, to make\textquotedblright{}. \emph{kardan}, \textquotedblleft{}to do\textquotedblright{}, is an inherited verb, from Middle Persian \emph{kardan} (EtymDB).
\end{cousinweb}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{جشن} \fa{گرفتن} (jashn gereftan)}{جشن گرفتن (jashn gereftan)}]{\fa{جشن} \fa{گرفتن} (jashn gereftan) — to celebrate}

\label{lesson:FA-C183-jashn-gereftan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for to talk, then the Persian for to marry.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{جشن} \fa{گرفتن}}
\textbf{\fa{جشن} \fa{گرفتن}} — \emph{jashn gereftan} — \textquotedblleft{}to celebrate\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{jashn gereftan} is \textquotedblleft{}to take a festival\textquotedblright{}: \emph{jashn} is usually traced to Middle Persian \emph{jašn}, \textquotedblleft{}festival\textquotedblright{}, from the old word for \textquotedblleft{}worship\textquotedblright{} that Avestan wrote \emph{yasna}. Both parts are native. \emph{gereftan}, \textquotedblleft{}to take\textquotedblright{}, is an inherited verb; EtymDB takes it back to the Indo-European root \emph{*g\textsuperscript{h}rebh\textsubscript{2}-}, \textquotedblleft{}to seize\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\textbf{\fa{آشنا} \fa{شدن}} — \emph{âshnâ shodan} — \textquotedblleft{}to get to know, to become acquainted\textquotedblright{}.
